arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The taxpayer claims the statute allows full deductions for unique trust costs.
The IRS contends these costs fall under a general deduction limit.
Justices questioned whether specific repairs are distinctive to trust management.
Justices asked about the burden of proof for claiming this exception.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute defines which trust expenses receive full tax deductions. It affects how trustees calculate taxable income for estates. It clarifies the boundary between unique trust duties and general investment costs.
